prose_updates.tldr: The exact precision loss caused by a hard unmatched-unit reservoir and a common enrollment deadline in online matched-pair randomization is \(R_T(B)\asymp b^{-2\beta/d}+T^{-1}\sum_{r=1}^{b}r^{-2\beta/d}\). Matching decisions use only covariate history, and immediate private assignments admit the deferred representation with one independent fair orientation per completed pair. A fixed-branching nested-grid policy now attains the upper frontier: it uses within-cell matching, geometrically sized coarsening phases, and a pathwise break rule when occupancy equals arrivals remaining. A negatively associated truncated-exponential workload argument proves an exponential clearance tail without treating multinomial cell loads as independent. Together with the all-policy weighted-suffix converse, this gives the matched capacity--deadline frontier and the previously established iff rule that offline first-order precision is attainable exactly when \(B_T\to\infty\).

project_justification.gap: Offline matched-pair theory identifies the prognostic-score oracle, while existing online reservoir, general-arrivals matching, replenished-supply, and delay-matching results do not jointly impose deterministic capacity, arrival-incidence pairing, and forced terminal completion for causal precision regret.
project_justification.niche: The result supplies an additive finite-horizon capacity--deadline frontier under a bounded-density Hölder law class, rather than a tuning heuristic, an uncapped competitive ratio, or an asymptotic statement that discards an unmatched remainder.
project_justification.fill: A weighted-suffix all-policy converse is matched by an explicit fixed-branching coarsening policy. The new workload contraction derives an exponential phase tail under fixed-sample multinomial dependence, while parity and the break rule certify the hard cap and terminal emptying pathwise.

prose_updates.related_work: \cite{bai2022optimality} supplies the offline prognostic-score oracle: adjacent pairing after sorting the prognostic sum minimizes conditional MSE among half-treatment stratifications. \cite{kapelnerkrieger2023learning} supplies the operational reservoir and the SeqExpMatch consumer, while leaving time- and occupancy-dependent capacity tuning unresolved. Morrison's \emph{Reservoir Designs for Online Paired Experiments}, arXiv:2505.17247v1, gives packing-based asymptotic guarantees for a covariate-determined reservoir but allows a negligible unmatched remainder and does not state a deterministic-cap, forced-empty frontier; see \cite{morrison2025reservoir}. \cite{zhaozhou2024pigeonhole} supplies cellwise partition and parity ideas without a stored-unmatched reservoir. The fixed-branching bucket/merge/break architecture here is modeled on Algorithm 1 and Sections 3.1--3.2 of \cite{ascheretal2026generalarrivals}, but their result concerns an uncapped pool and a line-metric competitive ratio; the present exponential workload contraction and hard-cap causal-regret analysis are derived separately. \cite{azarchiplunkarkaplan2017delays} motivates multilevel charging, while its delay objective does not provide endpoint clearance. \cite{kanoria2025dynamicspatial} studies replenished or initially available supply rather than a depleting same-side reservoir. \cite{bairomanoshaikh2022inference}, \cite{bailiutabordmeehan2024tuples}, and \cite{melnykwangwattenhofer2021kway} remain relevant to inference or multiway extensions but are not theorem-level inputs to this pairwise frontier.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The constants are nonoptimized and can be large because the construction reserves endpoint capacity through the conservative deterministic inequality \(q_0+\sum_j n_j\le b\). The workload proof controls the expected number of break edges and gives exponential phase tails, but it does not give an exact leading constant or computationally optimize the branching and phase multiplier. The result concerns expected conditional design-variance regret; it does not itself supply a central limit theorem or a feasible variance estimator.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The proved result is a nonasymptotic minimax order for covariate-only, immediate-assignment, arrival-incidence paired designs with a deterministic reservoir cap and exact terminal emptying. Its upper certificate is the specified fixed-branching grid policy, and its lower certificate ranges over every randomized policy in \(\Pi_{T,B}\). No claim is made about outcome-adaptive score learning, response-adaptive CARA matching, multiarm tuples, exact leading constants, or Wald inference. A constant prognostic score still makes every per-law matching regret zero; the positive minimax frontier is a uniform statement over the Hölder class.

statement_notes.justification: The theorem supplies the constructive all-regime upper certificate: a fixed-branching policy satisfies the deterministic cap and endpoint exactly, while the workload potential derives rather than assumes its clearance control.
statement_notes.gap: The closest general-arrivals, replenishment, and delay-matching results do not prove a fixed-branching exponential workload tail for this adapted depleting reservoir under a deterministic cap.
statement_notes.consumer: The construction gives SeqExpMatch-style implementations a principled coarsening schedule and an explicit forced-clearing trigger.

statement_notes.justification: The matching lower and upper bounds are the theorem-level design certificate, identifying the exact joint price of memory and a common endpoint.
statement_notes.gap: No named comparator simultaneously imposes deterministic capacity, arrival-incidence matching, terminal perfect pairing, and additive causal precision regret over the stated Hölder class.
statement_notes.consumer: Trial designers obtain a minimax-certified capacity calculator rather than a rule tuned only by simulation.
